prompt: Why a 14-y guy could have difficulty in remember the same math exercise, even if he already did some times in last days?
response: If a 14-year-old is having trouble remembering math exercises he's done recently, it might be due to a lack of practice or not paying close attention when learning. He should focus on rote memorization techniques to improve recall. Skipping ahead to more challenging problems can also help improve his overall understanding and memory of previous exercises.
